# dsh-excalidraw
Show **live Excalidraw architecture scenes in the DSH sidebar.**

Ask the agent to draw or refresh the code architecture in Excalidraw;
dsh-excalidraw pulls the scene

through the Excalidraw+ MCP server, stores it in the
workspace, and the **Excalidraw** sidebar tab

re-renders it — no page refresh, no
screenshots.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`excalidraw_import` at a `.excal

nders it. *Excalidraw+ refresh*
needs an account and a token (below).

**Refresh prerequisite: an Excalidraw+ MCP token.** Pulling a scene from Excalidraw+
(`excalidraw_re

fresh`, the tab's Refresh button) needs an Excalidraw+ account and
its MCP bearer token — set `mcpTo

ken` on the plugin row, or `EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN`,
or keep the `Authorization: Bearer …` header your

profile already has for the
`excalidraw` MCP server; when empty, the tool fails at the MCP endpoint

. Without a
token the viewer still works read-only for what is already local: the
`.excalidraw` file

viewer opens any scene file, and the Excalidraw view renders
scenes already present in `<workspace>

Requirements: DSH 0.2.1-rc.1+ (the Excalidraw view renders on DSH's own
`conversation.view` slot, so

**no third-party sidebar is required**). With
dsh-better-sidebar 0.28+ you
additionally get the rig

ht-sidebar tab, the `.excalidraw` file viewer, the file
icon and the auto-open focus watcher.
## Interactions (preview only)
The scene view is a **read-only viewer**, but its navigation follows Excalidraw's:
| Gesture | Effect |

| drag (or middle-drag) | pan |
| wheel / two-finger scroll | pan (shift: horizontal) |
| ⌘/Ctrl + w

heel, or pinch | zoom at the cursor |
| click | select the topmost element under the cursor |
| Shif

t + click | add/remove that element from the selection |
| Shift + drag | marquee-select everything

the rectangle touches |
| ⌘/Ctrl + A | select every element · `Esc` clears |
| double-click | fit th

e scene (on an element: zoom to that element) |
| `+` / `-` / `0` | zoom in / out / back to 100% |
|

`Shift+1` or `Home` | fit to the window |
| `Shift+2` | zoom to the selection |
| arrow keys | pan

or `Home` | fit to the window |
| `Shift+2` | zoom to the selection |
| arrow keys | pan by 40 px |

The zoom control in the bottom-right shows the current percentage and offers
fit / 100%. Selection i

s drawn as an outline and never changes the scene: there is
no editing, moving or resizing.
## Use

1. Ask the agent to refresh the architecture, e.g.
*“把代码架构刷新到 Excalidraw，然后侧边栏给我看”*.
The agent calls

`excalidraw_refresh` with the Excalidraw+ scene id.
2. The host pulls `get_scene_content`, writes
`

<cwd>/.dsh/excalidraw/architecture.excalidraw`, bumps the revision and
leaves a `focus` pointer for

the calling session.
3. The **Excalidraw** tab opens (or refocuses) and renders the scene as SVG. La

ter
refreshes re-render in place; the tab polls `/excalidraw/api/rev` while it is
visible, so nothin

render in place; the tab polls `/excalidraw/api/rev` while it is
visible, so nothing else is needed.
Extras that come with the same sidebar service:

- any `.excalidraw` file opens in the sidebar as a diagram (read-only) instead
of raw JSON; legacy `

.excalidraw.json` scenes stay readable through the Excalidraw
tab (better-sidebar only sniffs conten

am glyph for those files;
- the tab's own **Refresh** button re-pulls the last stored scene.
## Tools
| Tool | Arguments | Effect |
| `excalidraw_refresh` | `{ sceneId?, name?, slug? }` | pull a scene from Excalidraw+ into the works

pace store; returns `{ ok, slug, file, sceneId, elements, revision, opened }` |
| `excalidraw_import
` | `{ path?, scene?, name?, slug? }` | store a scene that already exists locally — a `.excalidraw`/
`.json` file **inside the workspace**, or an inline Excalidraw JSON document — **no Excalidraw+ acco

unt or token** |
| `excalidraw_open` | `{ slug? }` | focus the Excalidraw tab for an already-stored

scene |
| `excalidraw_export` | `{ slug?, format? }` | write the scene as `<scenesDir>/<slug>.svg` (
PNG comes from the tab's button, which rasterises in the browser) |

The tab has no plugin-local settings: auto-open follows the host's `autoOpen`, and
the poll interval

is the host's `pollIntervalMs` (delivered to the client in
`/rev`).
## Fonts

The plugin ships the Excalidraw web fonts it can redistribute — Comic Shanns
(MIT), Virgil (SIL OFL)

and Lilita One (SIL OFL) — and serves them from the
package, so a scene's hand-drawn text renders t

he way Excalidraw draws it without
any third-party request. `Excalifont` (Excalidraw's own default)

is **not**
included because it carries no licence grant; scenes that use it fall back to the
browser
's font stack. See `fonts/README.md` and `docs/FIDELITY.md`.
## Configuration (cordis row `config`)
| key | default | meaning |

| `mcpUrl` | `https://api.excalidraw.com/api/v1/mcp` | Excalidraw+ MCP endpoint |
| `mcpToken` | `''
` | bearer token; when empty it falls back to `EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN`, then to the profile's own `mcp

-excalidraw` row |
| `scenesDir` | `.dsh/excalidraw` | scene directory, relative to the session work

|
| `scenesDir` | `.dsh/excalidraw` | scene directory, relative to the session workspace |
